definition_en: in good health, good for your health, or large in amount
core_image: 清晨的操场上，人们慢跑，脸色红润

senses.title: In good health
senses.definition: In good health
senses.example: She looks healthy after the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 假期后她看起来很健康。
senses.why: Healthy is health plus -y, 'having the quality of'; it first described a person free from illness.
senses.whyCN: healthy 是 health 加 -y「具有……性质的」；它最初形容没有病的人。

senses.title: Good for your health
senses.definition: Good for your health
senses.example: Vegetables are a healthy choice.
senses.exampleCN: 蔬菜是有益健康的选择。
senses.why: Because a thing can also have the quality of health, the word moved from the person to the food or habit that keeps them well.
senses.whyCN: 因为事物也能带有健康的性质，这个词就从人转到指让人保持健康的食物或习惯。

senses.title: Large in amount or size
senses.definition: Large in amount or size
senses.example: The shop made a healthy profit.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店赚了可观的利润。
senses.why: A strong, well-functioning body suggests plenty, so healthy also means a large or satisfactory amount.
senses.whyCN: 强健运转的身体意味着充足，所以 healthy 也指数量大或令人满意。

definition_en: weighing a lot, great in amount or force, or hard to bear
core_image: 搬运工弯腰抱起一只装满书的木箱，手臂绷紧
scene: 搬运工弯腰抱起一只装满书的木箱，手臂绷紧。This box is too heavy to lift alone.
sceneCN: 这里 heavy 是「重的」（第 01 个义项）；句意是这个箱子太重，一个人抬不动。

pos.zh: 形容词：重的、大量的、繁重的

senses.title: Weighing a lot
senses.definition: Weighing a lot
senses.example: This box is too heavy to lift alone.
senses.exampleCN: 这个箱子太重，一个人抬不动。
senses.why: Old English hefig came from hebban, 'to lift'; something heavy is hard to lift.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 hefig 来自 hebban「举起」；重的东西难以举起。

senses.title: Great in amount or force
senses.definition: Great in amount or force
senses.example: Heavy rain flooded the road.
senses.exampleCN: 大雨淹了道路。
senses.why: Because a great mass presses down, heavy extends to anything present in large or forceful amount, like rain or traffic.
senses.whyCN: 因为巨大的质量向下压，heavy 引申指数量或力量大的事物，如雨或交通。

senses.title: Hard to bear or do
senses.definition: Hard to bear or do
senses.example: He has a heavy workload.
senses.exampleCN: 他的工作量很繁重。
senses.why: Work that weighs on a person is felt as heavy, so the word also describes duties that are hard to carry.
senses.whyCN: 压在人身上的工作让人感到沉重，所以这个词也形容难以承担的任务。

definition_en: tall or far above the ground, great in degree or amount, or sharp in pitch
core_image: 山顶的旗杆高过云层，旗子在风里猎猎作响
scene: 山顶的旗杆高过云层，旗子在风里猎猎作响。The flag flies high above the clouds.
sceneCN: 这里 high 是「高的」（第 01 个义项）；句意是这堵墙有两米高。

pos.zh: 形容词：高的、程度大的、尖的

senses.title: Tall or far above the ground
senses.definition: Tall or far above the ground
senses.definitionCN: 离地面远、从底到顶距离大
senses.example: The wall is two meters high.
senses.exampleCN: 这堵墙有两米高。
senses.why: Old English heah meant tall or lifted up; the word is Germanic and named height in space.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 heah 意为高耸；这个词属日耳曼语，本指空间上的高度。

senses.title: Great in degree or amount
senses.definition: Great in degree or amount
senses.example: The team scored a high total.
senses.exampleCN: 这个队得了很高的总分。
senses.why: Because height can be measured on a scale, high extends from physical space to prices, scores and standards.
senses.whyCN: 因为高度可以用刻度衡量，high 就从物理空间延伸到价格、分数与标准。

senses.title: Sharp in pitch
senses.definition: Sharp in pitch
senses.example: She sang a high note.
senses.exampleCN: 她唱了一个高音。

senses.whyCN: 音调升高让人感觉向上，所以 high 也形容尖而高的音符。

core_image: 雨后的小山包上，草色嫩绿，一条小路盘上去
scene: 雨后的小山包上，草色嫩绿，一条小路盘上去。They walked up the hill to the old church.
sceneCN: 这里 hill 是「小山」（第 01 个义项）；句意是他们爬上小山去那座老教堂。

senses.title: A raised piece of land, lower than a mountain

senses.example: They walked up the hill to the old church.
senses.exampleCN: 他们爬上小山去那座老教堂。
senses.why: Old English hyll named a natural rise in the land; it is Germanic and has stayed the everyday word for a low height.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 hyll 指自然隆起的地面；它属日耳曼语，一直是最常用的「小山」说法。

senses.title: A sloping road or piece of ground
senses.definition: A sloping road or piece of ground

senses.exampleCN: 汽车在陡坡上熄火了。
senses.why: Because a hill is climbed at an angle, the word also names the slope itself, as in a steep hill.
senses.whyCN: 因为上山要沿着斜面走，这个词也指斜面本身，如 a steep hill。

definition_en: to cause pain or injury, to feel pain, or to wound someone's feelings
core_image: 球场边，男孩捂着膝盖，队友蹲下来看他擦破的皮
scene: 球场边，男孩捂着膝盖，队友蹲下来看他擦破的皮。He hurt his knee during the game.
sceneCN: 这里 hurt 是「使受伤」（第 01 个义项）；句意是他在比赛中伤了膝盖。

pos.zh: 动词：使受伤、感到疼痛、伤害

senses.title: To cause pain or injury
senses.definition: To cause pain or injury
senses.example: He hurt his knee during the game.
senses.exampleCN: 他在比赛中伤了膝盖。
senses.why: Hurt came from Old French hurter, to strike; the word first meant to hit and then to cause pain.
senses.whyCN: hurt 源自古法语 hurter「击打」；最初指打击，后指造成疼痛。

senses.title: To feel pain
senses.definition: To feel pain
senses.example: My throat hurts when I swallow.
senses.exampleCN: 我咽东西时喉咙疼。
senses.why: Because a blow is felt by the body, the verb also works without an object, naming the pain itself.
senses.whyCN: 因为打击会被身体感觉到，这个动词也能不带宾语，直接表示疼痛。

senses.title: To wound someone's feelings
senses.definition: To wound someone's feelings
senses.example: His words hurt her deeply.
senses.exampleCN: 他的话深深伤害了她。
senses.why: Pain is not only physical, so hurt extends to the sting left by unkind words or actions.
senses.whyCN: 疼痛不只属于身体，hurt 也引申指刻薄言语或行为留下的刺痛。

definition_en: a piece of land surrounded by water, or a raised area in the middle of a road
core_image: 海面上，一座小岛被白浪围住，椰树的影子落在沙滩上
scene: 海面上，一座小岛被白浪围住，椰树的影子落在沙滩上。The boat reached the island before noon.
sceneCN: 这里 island 是「岛」（第 01 个义项）；句意是船在中午前到达了那个岛。

senses.title: A piece of land surrounded by water
senses.definition: A piece of land surrounded by water
senses.example: The boat reached the island before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 船在中午前到达了那个岛。
senses.why: Old English igland joined ieg, 'island', with land; the s was added later under the influence of Latin insula and is not pronounced.

senses.whyCN: 因为交通安全岛是被车流围住的一小块安全地，就借用了四周环水之地的名字。
